title: Hamiltonian group actions in cosymplectic geometry
summary: We develop a theory of Hamiltonian group actions on cosymplectic manifolds. These odd-dimensional manifolds combine a codimension-one symplectic foliation with a distinguished Reeb direction, and arise naturally both in stable Hamiltonian geometry and as critical hypersurfaces of $b$-symplectic manifolds. Our approach is based on a compact symplectic thickening process: every cosymplectic manifold $(M,α,β)$ gives rise to a symplectic manifold $(M\times \mathbb{S}^1,\ β+ \mathrm{d}θ\wedgeα)$.
